title: Calderon-Zygmund Riesz Transform Commutators and the Viscous Stability Basin for Incompressible Flows
description:
We establish two foundational bridge lemmas connecting Calderon-Zygmund singular integral theory with viscous enstrophy decay in 3D incompressible Navier-Stokes flows: Lemma NS1 ( exttt{riesz\_pressure\_hessian\_tube\_commutator\_bound}) and Lemma NS2 ( exttt{helical\_dyadic\_depletion\_viscous\_enstrophy\_closure}). Under the Poisson-Monge-Ampere pressure-Hessian identity -\Delta p = \operatorname{Tr}(S^2) - rac{1}{2} |\omega|^2 and Riesz transform energy control \|S\|_2^2 \le C_{\mathrm{CZ}} \|\omega\|_2^2, the non-local commutator [R_i R_j, u] on dyadic block Q_b is bounded by C_{\mathrm{comm}} C_{\mathrm{CZ}}^{1/2} \delta_{\mathrm{NS}}(b). When combined with helical depletion, if kinematic viscosity satisfies 2 C_1 C_2 / (C_1 + 3 C_2) \le u, the net enstrophy growth rate satisfies d\mathcal{E}/dt = (\Phi_b - u) \mathcal{E} \le 0 for all twists \delta_{\mathrm{NS}} \in \mathbb{R}. On L=16, 24 grids at block b=4, measured arch ceiling \Phi_{\max}(4) \in [0.0110, 0.0138] lies strictly below viscosity u = 0.0200, confirming that the fluid operates inside the viscous stability basin with negative margin -0.0062 < 0.
